Absolutely awful experience. I bought two items from this store.. a dog treat and shoes for my dog. I didn’t take the receipt, so I called the very next day to return the shoes after trying them on my dog at home and realizing they didn’t fit at all.

I gave them every possible detail: the exact two items purchased, the total amount of the bill, the approximate time of purchase, and anything else they needed to locate the transaction in their system. Instead of helping, I was left on hold for 10 minutes, only to be told over and over again:

Sorry, we can’t check our system.
Sorry, we can’t return it.
Sorry, we can’t help you.
Sorry, there’s nothing we can do.

Just excuses. Zero effort. Zero solutions.

Customer service here is NON existent when you actually need help. Funny how they’re super friendly when you’re handing over your money, but the moment there’s an issue, that fake niceness disappears completely.

This store clearly doesn’t care about its customers once the sale is done. I will never return, and I will definitely warn everyone I know to avoid this place. Plenty of other pet stores out there that actually value their customers.. this is NOT one of them.

Thank you for replying, However..

First, declining the receipt was not an oversight.. it simply meant I had no intention of returning the item at the time of purchase. I didn't see the need to take it. That should not automatically eliminate all options for customer support less than 24 hours later.

Second, if your system is unable to locate a transaction that occurred within the next day without a receipt or customer account, then that points to a serious limitation in your internal system. That is NOT something a customer should be penalized for.

Third, what was most disappointing is that no alternative solution was offered.. NOT an exchange, NOT a store credit, NOT any form of goodwill gesture. Customer service is not only about enforcing policy, but also about problem solving and supporting clients when issues arise.

Lastly, while you emphasize that your return policy is "clearly displayed," customers come into a pet store to find what they need for their pets and to have a positive experience.. not to read policy notices. If policies are truly non negotiable, then staff should be trained to clearly and verbally communicate this BEFORE payment is completed.

Beyond all of this, this was honestly the worst pet store experience I've ever had. Pet stores are usually happy places and welcoming where customers feel supported and leave with a good experience. Unfortunately, this store was the complete opposite.. inflexible, dismissive, and lacking basic customer care.

I stand by my feedback and would NOT recommend this store to anyone!

I love the variety of treat options available at the Bone and Biscuit! The store is always clean and organized every time I come in. The staff is always so friendly and ready to help. I highly recommend this store for all your pet’s needs! :)

Such a wonderful pet store!

First off this store is VERY small, no one seems to mention this.

The staff has no control over anything, watched them hold the leash of a dog at the counter as to lunged and growled at two other dogs that came in. Those dogs left but the staff did not even ask the owner with the aggressive dog to leave. They actually appeared to be laughing as the dogs owner continued to rummage through the loose dog treats.

I did not feel safe taking my dog in and would suggest you do the same
